# NEW 2026-11-18 round 3 N2 casus belli (oe_tcb_). Generated by gen_round3_cb.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Hardcoded hooks append to the existing handlers.
on_took_location_in_peace_treaty = { on_actions = { oe_tcb_took_location } }
on_winning_war = { on_actions = { oe_tcb_won_war } }
on_ending_war = { on_actions = { oe_tcb_ended_war } }
on_location_changed_owner = { on_actions = { oe_tcb_owner_changed } }
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_tcb_monthly } }
yearly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_tcb_yearly } }

# root = winner, scope:location, scope:winner, scope:loser. Fires for each location of a peace before on_winning_war
# (vanilla religious_order_conquest.txt relies on this order). Counts the former provinces BYZ takes.
oe_tcb_took_location = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = scope:winner
                exists = scope:location
                scope:winner = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
                scope:location = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_province }
            }
            scope:winner = {
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcb_taken_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_tcb_taken_n value = 0 } }
                change_variable = { name = oe_tcb_taken_n add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}
# root = country, scope:winner, scope:loser, scope:war. A reclaim war won by BYZ as attacker: Orthodox relief.
# Participants (and the loser) are marked so they do not count as uninvolved; the marks are removed at once.
oe_tcb_won_war = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = scope:winner
                exists = scope:war
                scope:winner = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no has_variable = oe_tcb_taken_n }
                scope:war = { casus_belli ?= casus_belli:oe_tcb_reclaim is_an_attacker = scope:winner }
            }
            scope:war = { every_war_participant = { set_variable = oe_tcb_in_war } }
            scope:loser ?= { set_variable = oe_tcb_in_war }
            scope:winner = { oe_tcb_apply_relief = yes }
            scope:war = { every_war_participant = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tcb_in_war } remove_variable = oe_tcb_in_war } }
            scope:loser ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tcb_in_war } remove_variable = oe_tcb_in_war } }
        }
    }
}
# root = each side's country after the war. Drops a count left by a peace that was not a won reclaim war.
oe_tcb_ended_war = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no has_variable = oe_tcb_taken_n }
    effect = { remove_variable = oe_tcb_taken_n }
}
# root = location. A former province passing to anyone but BYZ opens the gate at once (the yearly recount closes it).
oe_tcb_owner_changed = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1200
        has_variable = oe_tw_former_province
        NOT = { owner ?= { tag = BYZ } }
    }
    effect = {
        c:BYZ ?= { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcb_open } } set_variable = oe_tcb_open } }
    }
}
# Once per game or loaded save: set the gate from the marks already on the map.
oe_tcb_monthly = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcb_init } }
    effect = {
        set_variable = oe_tcb_init
        oe_tcb_recount = yes
    }
}
oe_tcb_yearly = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
    effect = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tcb_open } oe_tcb_recount = yes }
        # Safety net: a count left over from a separate peace.
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tcb_taken_n at_war = no } remove_variable = oe_tcb_taken_n }
    }
}
